description: PIVSIA crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 2/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C4 H12 Ce2 N15 O23 1-,C2 H5 N4 1+. From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce2 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.676-4.676 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 139.93-139.93°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [4-NH2-1,2,4-HTriaz][Ce2(μ2-4-NH2-1,2,4-Triaz)2(μ2-NO3)(NO3)6(H2O)2]. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 6 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
